scripts.build:windows: cd apps/desktop && pnpm tauri build && copy src-tauri\target\release\applio-app.exe ..\..\build\applio-app.exe && cd ..\server && pyinstaller --onefile --icon=logo.ico --noconsole server.py && copy dist\server.exe ..\..\build\server.exe
scripts.build:macos: cd apps/desktop && pnpm tauri build && cp src-tauri/target/release/applio-app ../../../build/applio-app && cd ../server && pyinstaller --onefile --icon=logo.ico --noconsole server.py && cp dist/server ../../../build/server
scripts.server:macos: cd apps/server && source env/bin/activate && python server.py
